verdict: Clean, and the longest floor so far: the bot's first run ran out of its 2400 game seconds just before the gate (everything else done); given 3200 it cleared in 2241 s with all four stars and no fall, under the floor's own par (2332 s). No console error, every spot reachable; the caravan, the rival (Fenna), the trial, the Sun-Eater (the Sphinx's model, tinted) and the gate (Brannoc) all played.

found.text: In the first picture only her mark showed, over the caravanserai's roof. She stands on the sand beside its wall (the probe finds no person in cover).

found.text: The tombs' and the mud fort's packs slept through the bot's route; the probe: the lair wall's gold edge into the dune, crates on the rim's slope, red rocks a little sunk.
